Name: Simple Bridge Mod (CP)
Author: Warilized
TagLine: More Coordinated Bridges! No more frail looking plank!
Description:
"Hey, that bridge looks dangerous" you said? Fret not! "Simple Bridge Mod" to the rescue!

With the latest technology of woodworking and bridge designing, we can replace your poor looking plank bridge with the one we choose!
-------------------------------**About this mod:**
This is a bridge replacer/retexture mod. It replaces vanilla bridge sprites with neat looking ones!

This mod is basically a CP version of [this mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1767) .

**What's New:**

*   Fix Bugs.

*   Fix Colors.

*   New Features.
**Installation:**

1.  First, you need to have [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) and [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400), or else this mod is useless.

2.  If this is your first installation, skip this step. Before placing the mod into "Mods" folder, deleting old mod file is recommended to avoid some problems.

3.  Unzip this mod paste it into "Mods" folder.

4.  Done
**Uninstallation:**

1.  Delete the mod.

2.  Done.
**This Mod Contains:**

*   Bridges from [this mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1767)  by Toastshark.

*   Patch for [A Less Yellow Stardew](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2415)  - Light Dirt (It is for Grass 1, but other grass version might work)
**Configurations:**

*   Enable Mod: "true/false" - Enables the mod.

*   Style: "Style Name" - Recolor Style.
**Notes:**

*   You can add your own custom bridge albeit limited (on prepared folders)

*   If you wanted to create a patch for recolors, there's template folder named ".template" (it will be a hidden folder in some pc) so you can start creating your own.
**Making/Editing Bridge Sprite):**

1.  Just edit the files in the assets as template/reference.

2.  Done. You can upload it anywhere with the loader.
**Planned Updates:**

*   TBD.
**ATTENTION:**

*   I'm not taking any request to patch this mod texture to match any retexture someone had done, except if I like it or use it.
**Compatibility Issues:**

*   Mods that replaces the same area in the "{{season}}_outdoorsTileSheet.xnb".
**Credits:**

*   "[SimpleBridge Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1767)" by toastshark
**Disclaimer:**
This mod is only available only on NexusMods under "Warilized" username.
